instruction: Launch the annual enterprise survey spreadsheet in LibreOffice Calc, export to HTML Document format, and save as 'survey-table.html' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the annual enterprise survey XLSX file in LibreOffice Calc, exporting it to HTML format, and saving as 'survey-table.html' on Desktop. Evaluator checks if the file exists at the expected location.
metadata.verification: Verified that HTML export to 'survey-table.html' is a standard LibreOffice Calc export option. File existence check is appropriate for this task.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage - evaluator checks file existence, HTML format, content presence, and table elements
Semantic correctness - getter extracts all necessary validation flags (exists, is_html, has_content, has_table)
Logical flow is correct - metric validates all aspects of successful HTML export
HTML validation is robust - checks for multiple HTML indicators (<html>, <!doctype html>, <meta>)
Table content verification - ensures spreadsheet data was exported (checks for <table>, <td>, <tr> tags)
Edge cases handled - empty files rejected (size > 100 bytes), non-HTML files rejected, missing tables rejected
Practical implementation - uses bash commands to check file state on VM, reads first 4KB for validation
All instruction requirements verified - file location, HTML format, and spreadsheet content all checked
